title: CINDER V2 | Kill Aura, Aimbot, ESP + Ocean Auto Farm
features:
Cinder V2 for Last Stop [Beta], with Ocean Biome support.

COMBAT
- Kill Aura with adjustable range and automatic target facing
- Aimbot with Head / Body selection
- Crosshair-based target switching and adjustable aim radius
- Visibility checks

ESP & VISUALS
- Enemy and boss ESP
- Friendly / NPC ESP
- Named loot ESP with adjustable range
- Fuel-only filter, shop stock and bus ESP
- Entity highlights and Fullbright

OCEAN EVENT
- Auto-collect loaded Ocean Tokens and return

LOOT & SURVIVAL
- Auto pickup with adjustable range
- Auto eat with adjustable hunger threshold

SELLING & CRAFTING
- Batch or single-item auto sell
- Item filters and All / Limited batch sizes
- Travel to sell and return
- Recipe dropdown and adjustable crafting quantity
- Inventory sorting

BUS & MOVEMENT
- Auto tutorial: install starting wheels and add fuel
- Bus fuel and wheel status
- Adjustable walk speed and flight speed
- Infinite jump and Noclip

EXTRAS
- Anti-AFK
- Compact, draggable UI
- Custom menu hotkeys
